note: “Without sugar” still contains Sugar, plus Negation. Inside If Sugar IN Orders, test If Negation IN Orders, then Write 0 Sugar or Write 1 Sugar.
solution:
POSITION listen
LISTEN
TAKE UP
IF tea IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
  ITEM tea
ELSE
  ITEM coffee
END
IF sugar IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
  IF negation IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
    WRITE 0 sugar
  ELSE
    WRITE 1 sugar
  END
END
MOVE RIGHT 1
DEPOSIT RIGHT
MOVE LEFT 1
JUMP listen
